line: ASUS Zenbook 14 OLED (2026, UX3480AA, Intel Panther Lake)
config_name: Zenbook 14 OLED — Core Ultra 7 355 (Panther Lake), 16GB, 512GB SSD, 14" 2K 60Hz glossy OLED

specs.keyboard_notes: White backlit, 1.7mm travel, oversized glass touchpad

battery.notes: 70Wh. UBR: 'one of the quietest, coolest-running, and most efficient Windows ultrabooks we've tested in a long while'.

price.notes: UBR reviewed price 1399 EUR (~US$1,500); AMD sibling sells CA$1,999 at BBY, Intel runs ~EUR100 higher. Intel UX3480AA CA retail not directly verified.

offers.name: ASUS Zenbook 14 14" OLED Laptop - AMD Ryzen AI 7 445 - 16GB LPDDR5X - 512GB SSD - Windows 11 Home - Jade Black

reviews.quote: It's also one of the quietest, coolest-running, and most efficient Windows ultrabooks we've tested in a long while in this Intel Panther Lake variant.
this series is no longer as competitively priced as previous-gen Zenbooks were in their day, and I would recommend straying away from the 2K OLED display as much as possible

praises: Panther Lake efficiency gives best-in-class battery for a Windows x86 14-incher
Effectively silent under normal loads; fans rarely spin
Ceraluminum chassis feels tougher and cleaner than the UX3405 it replaces
Full port set (TB4 + USB-A + HDMI) without dongles
complaints: Dim 2K OLED with PWM flicker at all brightness levels — reviewer explicitly advises avoiding this panel
Ultra 7 355 variant is 'only a mid-performer' per UBR; Ultra 9 386H is the one to get
Hinge no longer opens flat (180° lost)
Price premium over the AMD sibling isn't obviously justified at identical panel/RAM

design_philosophy: The 2026 UX3480 unifies ASUS's Zenbook design language (Ceraluminum, A14-like aesthetics) across Intel/AMD/Qualcomm variants in one chassis. The Intel Panther Lake variant is the most efficient and refined of the three, aimed at battery-first road warriors — but the shared entry 2K OLED panel is the line's weak point.
rating_notes: Ratings anchored on Ultrabookreview's UX3480AA review (Core Ultra 7 355, 4/5) — this is the as-reviewed config tier; +0.5 battery/thermals_noise vs AMD sibling 80 for Panther Lake efficiency edge per UBR. Dim PWM OLED caps readability_bright 5, screen_quality 7. Image is the AMD-sibling BBY photo (same chassis).
